stem:
A school librarian surveyed 80 randomly selected students about their favorite type of book. The results are shown in the table.

Favorite Type of Book

| Type of Book | Number of Students |
|--------------|--------------------|
| Action       | 24                 |
| Mystery      | 14                 |
| Fantasy      | 15                 |
| Nonfiction   | 9                  |
| Biography    | 18                 |

Based on the results in the table, which types of books make the statements about a randomly selected student true?
instruction: Move the correct answer to each box. Not all answers will be used.
response_template:
The student is more than twice as likely to prefer [blank_1] as to prefer [blank_2].

The student is equally likely to prefer Action as to prefer Nonfiction or [blank_3].
